interest: Shows 1930s Nagoya bank failures, Ministry currency rules, and the politically fraught Bank of Japan governorship change.
overview: Docket (1930-37) on Japanese banking: Nagoya bank failures, currency-deposit rules, Chinese staff at Japanese banks, Yokohama Specie Bank's New York agency, and Governor Ikeda's appointment and resignation amid China-policy tension.
